data.title: Broadcom Stock Plunges Over 11% As Semiconductor Selloff Hits Tech Giants
data.description: Broadcom stock dropped over 9% on Friday as a steep semiconductor selloff, AI spending concerns, and U.S.-China export rules weighed on tech shares. See what Dec. 9 earnings and Wall Street targets mean for AVGO.
